name: The Whitley, a Luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: The Whitley, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Atlanta Buckhead: luxury hotel in Buckhead with a full spa floor, a glass-roofed indoor pool and rooms with bay windows over Buckhead
best_for: Travelers who want a Buckhead base near Phipps Plaza and Lenox Square
Guests who want a spa floor and an indoor pool in a city hotel

facts.text: The Whitley is a luxury hotel in Buckhead, Atlanta, near Phipps Plaza.
The hotel offers easy access to Lenox Square and LEGOLAND Discovery Center Atlanta.
The hotel sits near the upscale department stores and indie art galleries around Miami Circle and Bennett Street.
The decor pairs jade greens with creams and dark woods, with pops of gold in flower pots, throw pillows and sconces.
Rocking chairs in the living room recall a wraparound porch.
Rooms and suites have high ceilings and a featherbed with Egyptian cotton sheets.
Bathrooms have two mirrors, Italian marble countertops and a tiled shower.
Spa treatments include facials, body scrubs, salon services, manicures and pedicures.
Spa guests can relax in the lounge, an indoor saline pool and a whirlpool.
Trade Root Restaurant & Lounge serves Southern fine dining, with ingredients sourced from local suppliers in Buckhead.
The Legacy Ballroom has an outdoor terrace overlooking the Atlanta skyline.

highlights.text: A dedicated floor holds the spa, with a lounge, boutique, treatment rooms and a Himalayan salt room.
The indoor heated pool has a glass roof that lets in natural light.
Rooms have large bay windows with panoramic views of Buckhead.
The Whitley Suite has sweeping views of Atlanta and Buckhead, a dining room with a butler's pantry and an entertainment area with a billiards table.
The suites use Egyptian cotton linens by Frette.

considerations.text: Pets are welcome only if they weigh less than 50 pounds.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
